root_causes_fixed.1_heartbeat_non_renewal: ksadk/kernel/bootstrap.py: lease renewal only happened for sessions with pending inbox work; completed/waiting-approval sessions stayed in the heartbeat set without renewal, so after TTL readiness flipped not-ready. Fix: dedicated heartbeat background task renews all held leases on a TTL/3 cadence; renewal also cannot be starved by a slow adapter.start() in the run loop (commit bb2fe85c + 8891ebd4).
root_causes_fixed.2_readiness_ownership: readiness now treats a lease owned by a different activation as lost (truthful not-ready on takeover).
root_causes_fixed.3_interaction_guard_row_scoping: ksadk/kernel/postgres_store.py + memory_store.py: interaction ledger fence lookup selected an activation row by activation_id alone; one pod holds leases for multiple sessions, so the wrong session's row could be returned and every interaction request failed StaleFenceError (runs stuck in 'running'). Fix: scope lookup to (activation_id, agent_instance_id, session_id) (commit 0bdbb62e).
root_causes_fixed.4_typed_runtime_store_reads: ksadk/events/canonical_store.py: hosted PG fenced session event store has no session_service; RuntimeEventStore reads (cold recovery scan / resolve_existing) raised AttributeError so takeover recovery always failed and a fresh pod entered degraded on restart with any open run. Fix: envelope-store read fallback (commit 663e5363).
root_causes_fixed.5_observability: background stream task failures are now logged at ERROR instead of silently captured (commit 01584d14) - this is what made 3 diagnosable.
